alarms.text: Cost per lead is 67.36 versus a prior median of 35.63.

campaigns.campaign_name: KS/MM- DCT- LEAD-La Bella Sea Girt-$.9.50 + Free Consultation/ Facial Analysis- CBO

insights.creative: The video ad brought 2 of the 4 Meta leads on $31.52. It opens 'Smoother Skin Starts with One Appointment' and offers tox at $9.50 per unit with a free consultation and skin analysis. The returning-visitor ad also brought 2, on $73.97, and opens 'We're Looking for 15 People Who've Been Thinking About Tox'. The two image ads brought none. Worth testing a second short video on the same offer, since video brought leads at the lowest cost.
insights.doing: 2 leads reached the CRM this week at $67.36 each, down from 6 at $24.43 the week before, on $134.73 of spend. Meta counted 4. With this few leads it is too early to call it a trend.
insights.look_into: The cost per CRM lead of $67.36 is well above the usual level, against a prior median of $35.63. Meta counted 4 leads but only 2 reached the CRM, so worth checking whether the other 2 came through.
insights.next: We recommend keeping the budget where it is for one more week, since 2 leads is too few to judge, and checking that every Meta lead form reaches the CRM.
